Faq.subtitle: Questions our clients commonly ask
Faq.q1: How is the Windows optimization process carried out?
Faq.a1: The optimization is performed 100% remotely, using AnyDesk, a secure and widely recognized remote access software. An UpBoost specialist accesses your computer with your permission, while you follow every step in real time on your own monitor. You don't need to install anything other than AnyDesk. Throughout the process, you maintain full control and can end the session at any time. The service follows a clear and transparent protocol from start to finish, conducted by professionals with experience in game system optimization.
Faq.a2: UpBoost has served more than 12,000 clients, with hundreds of positive reviews visible in our social media highlights. We work with recognized and secure tools such as AnyDesk, and you follow every step of the service live, with no hidden actions. We also offer a satisfaction guarantee: if the results don't meet expectations, we review the service at no additional cost. Our reputation has been built client by client, with real, verifiable, and proven results.
Faq.q3: Do I need to pay monthly?
Faq.a3: No. Payment is made only once, with no recurring fees or subscriptions. The optimizations are applied directly to the operating system and remain active permanently. They are only removed if you format the computer. In that case, just contact our team and we'll reapply them for free, within the support period included in your plan.
Faq.q4: Do I need to buy a package for each game I play?
Faq.a4: You don't need to. UpBoost optimization works on the Windows operating system as a whole. This means all games, apps, and overall computer performance benefit from a single service. Whether it's CS2, Valorant, FiveM, Fortnite, or any other title, the FPS gain, input lag reduction, and improved stability apply to all of them at once. You don't need to hire separate packages for each game.
Faq.q5: How long does the optimization process take?
Faq.a5: The complete process takes between 20 and 30 minutes, varying depending on the chosen plan and your PC's settings. Throughout that time, you follow in real time every adjustment being made to your system. At the end of the session, the specialist explains the main changes made and you can immediately test the difference in your first match.
